Enabled.Name: Enabled
Enabled.Hint: If enabled, currency will be generated for tokens dropped in scenes.

ShowChatMessage.Name: Show Chat Message
ShowChatMessage.Hint: If enabled, a chat message will be created any time currency is generated.

CreatureTypes.Name: Creature Types
CreatureTypes.Hint: These are the types of creatures that will generate currency, separated via semi-colons. This will match on their type, subtype, and custom type. Leave it blank to generate currency for all types of creatures. Example: Humanoid;Aberration;Monstrosity

ChanceOfNoCurrency.Name: Chance of No Currency
ChanceOfNoCurrency.Hint: This is the percent chance that no money will be generated for a token.

CurrencyMultiplier.Name: Currency Multiplier
CurrencyMultiplier.Hint: This multiplies the generated currency by the given number.

UseSilver.Name: Use Silver
UseSilver.Hint: If enabled, generated currency could include silver. Copper is always included.

UseElectrum.Name: Use Electrum
UseElectrum.Hint: If enabled, generated currency could include electrum. Copper is always included.

UseGold.Name: Use Gold
UseGold.Hint: If enabled, generated currency could include gold. Copper is always included.

UsePlatinum.Name: Use Platinum
UsePlatinum.Hint: If enabled, generated currency could include platinum. Copper is always included.
